translations.idiomatic: Now he is specially favored; it will surely be said that the whole court deceives while Yanru alone gives his body for the state, making Your Majesty believe no court minister is trustworthy—whereupon Yanru can cut down those he resents, advance those he favors, and say he is avenging Feng Quan, Huo Weihua, and the like.

sentences.zh: 此一召也，於國事無纖毫益，而於聖德有丘山之損。

translations.literal: This one summons brings not the slightest benefit to state affairs but a mountain-high loss to sacred virtue."
translations.idiomatic: This one summons brings not the slightest benefit to state affairs but a mountain-high loss to Your Majesty's reputation."

sentences.zh: 」忤旨，詰責。

translations.literal: Offending the imperial will, he was rebuked and questioned.
translations.idiomatic: Offending the imperial will, he was rebuked and questioned.

sentences.zh: 已，復列上五事，曰舉謀勇，止援兵，練土著，密偵探，選守令，俱見采納。

translations.literal: Later he again submitted five items: promoting strategists and the brave, halting relief troops, training local forces, tightening espionage, and selecting prefects and magistrates—all were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again submitted five items: promoting strategists and the brave, halting relief troops, training local forces, tightening espionage, and selecting prefects and magistrates—all were adopted.

sentences.zh: 累遷刑部侍郎，遂代鄭三俊為本部尚書。

translations.literal: He rose through offices to Vice Minister of Justice and then replaced Zheng Sanjun as minister of that ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to Vice Minister of Justice and then replaced Zheng Sanjun as minister of that ministry.

sentences.zh: 之鳳以天下囚徒皆五年一審錄，高墻罪獨不與，上疏言之，報可。

translations.literal: Zhifeng noted that prisoners throughout the realm were reviewed every five years but those in the high-walled prison were excluded alone; he memorialized on this and received approval.
translations.idiomatic: Zhifeng noted that prisoners throughout the realm were reviewed every five years but those in the high-walled prison alone were excluded; he memorialized on this and received approval.

sentences.zh: 嘗與左侍郎王命璿召對平臺，論律例及獄情，帝申飭而退。

translations.literal: Once he and Left Vice Minister Wang Mingxuan were summoned to audience at the Terrace of Peace, discussed statutes and prison cases, and the emperor gave stern instructions and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: Once he and Left Vice Minister Wang Mingxuan were summoned to audience at the Terrace of Peace, discussed statutes and prison cases, and the emperor gave stern instructions and dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 時有火星之變，之鳳特請修刑，言：「自今獄情大者，一月奏斷，小者半月。

translations.literal: When Mars underwent an irregular movement, Zhifeng specially asked to reform punishments, saying: "From now on major cases shall be reported and decided within one month, minor ones within half a month."
translations.idiomatic: When Mars underwent an irregular movement, Zhifeng specially asked to reform punishments, saying, "From now on major cases shall be reported and decided within one month, minor ones within half a month."

sentences.zh: 贓重人犯，結案在數年前者，大抵本犯無髓可敲，戚屬亦無脂可吸。

translations.literal: For heavy bribery offenders whose cases were concluded years ago, generally the principal offender has no marrow left to squeeze and relatives no fat left to suck.
translations.idiomatic: For heavy bribery offenders whose cases were concluded years ago, generally the principal offender has nothing left to squeeze from and relatives no wealth left to extort.

sentences.zh: 祈悉宥免，全好生之仁。

translations.literal: I pray that all be pardoned and exempted to preserve the virtue of cherishing life."
translations.idiomatic: I pray that all be pardoned and exempted to preserve the virtue of cherishing life."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 然之鳳雖為此奏，其後每上獄詞，帝必嚴駁，之鳳懼甚，諸司呈稿，遲疑不敢遽發，屢疏謝病，帝不從。

translations.literal: Yet although Zhifeng made this memorial, afterward whenever prison reports went up the emperor sternly rejected them; Zhifeng was greatly afraid, the various offices hesitated over drafts and dared not send them promptly, and he repeatedly memorialized to resign on grounds of illness—the emperor would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Yet although Zhifeng made this memorial, afterward whenever prison reports went up the emperor sternly rejected them; Zhifeng was greatly afraid, the various offices hesitated over drafts and dared not send them promptly, and he repeatedly memorialized to resign on grounds of illness—the emperor would not agree.

sentences.zh: 會尚書範景文劾南京給事中荊可棟貪墨，下部訊，之鳳予輕比。

translations.literal: When Minister Fan Jingwen impeached Nanjing supervising secretary Jing Kedong for corruption and the case was sent down for investigation, Zhifeng gave a light sentence.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister Fan Jingwen impeached Nanjing supervising secretary Jing Kedong for corruption and the case was sent down for investigation, Zhifeng gave a light sentence.

sentences.zh: 帝疑其受賄，下之吏，法司希旨坐絞。

translations.literal: The emperor suspected he had taken bribes, handed him over to the judicial authorities, and the law officers, seeking to please, sentenced him to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected he had taken bribes, handed him over to the judicial authorities, and the law officers, seeking to please, sentenced him to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 給事中李清言於律未合，同官葛樞復論救。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary Li Qing said this did not accord with the law; his colleague Ge Shu again argued for his rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Li Qing said this did not accord with the law; his colleague Ge Shu again argued for his rescue.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，鐫樞級，調外。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry, reduced Shu's rank by inscription, and transferred him outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry, reduced Shu's rank by inscription, and transferred him outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月，之鳳獄中上書自白無贓賄，情可矜原。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year, from prison Zhifeng submitted a letter declaring himself innocent of bribery and asking that his case be treated with compassion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year, from prison Zhifeng submitted a letter declaring himself innocent of bribery and asking that his case be treated with compassion.

sentences.zh: 亦置不省，竟瘐死。

translations.literal: This too was set aside without notice, and he ultimately died of illness in prison.
translations.idiomatic: This too was ignored, and he ultimately died of illness in prison.

sentences.zh: 計崇禎朝刑部易尚書十七人。

translations.literal: In all, seventeen men held the post of Minister of Justice in the Chongzhen reign.
translations.idiomatic: In all, seventeen men held the post of Minister of Justice during the Chongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 薛貞以奄黨抵死。

translations.literal: Xue Zhen died at the hands of the eunuch faction.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Zhen was put to death as a member of the eunuch faction.

sentences.zh: 蘇茂相半歲而罷。

translations.literal: Su Maoxiang was dismissed after half a year.
translations.idiomatic: Su Maoxiang was dismissed after half a year.

sentences.zh: 王在晉未任，改兵部。

translations.literal: Wang Zaijin did not take office and was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zaijin did not take office and was transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 喬允升坐逸囚遣戍。

translations.literal: Qiao Yunsheng was banished to frontier service for allowing a prisoner to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Yunsheng was banished to frontier service for allowing a prisoner to escape.

sentences.zh: 韓繼思坐議獄除名。

translations.literal: Han Jisi was struck from the rolls for debating a prison case.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jisi was struck from the rolls for debating a prison case.

sentences.zh: 胡應臺獨得善去。

translations.literal: Hu Yingtai alone departed with a favorable outcome.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yingtai alone left office with honor intact.

sentences.zh: 馮英被劾遣戍。

translations.literal: Feng Ying was impeached and sent to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ying was impeached and sent to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 鄭三俊坐議獄逮系。

translations.literal: Zheng Sanjun was arrested and imprisoned for debating a prison case.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Sanjun was arrested and imprisoned for debating a prison case.

sentences.zh: 之鳳論絞，瘐死獄中。

translations.literal: Zhifeng was sentenced to strangulation and died of illness in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Zhifeng was sentenced to strangulation and died of illness in prison.

sentences.zh: 甄淑坐納賄下詔獄，改系刑部，瘐死。

translations.literal: Zhen Shu was imprisoned in the imperial prison for taking bribes, transferred to the Ministry of Justice, and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Shu was imprisoned in the imperial prison for taking bribes, transferred to the Ministry of Justice, and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 李覺斯坐議獄削籍。

translations.literal: Li Juesi was struck from the rolls for debating a prison case.
translations.idiomatic: Li Juesi was struck from the rolls for debating a prison case.

sentences.zh: 劉澤深卒於位。

translations.literal: Liu Zeshen died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zeshen died in office.

sentences.zh: 鄭三俊再為尚書，改吏部。

translations.literal: Zheng Sanjun again became minister and was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Sanjun again became minister and was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 範景文未任，改工部。

translations.literal: Fan Jingwen did not take office and was transferred to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Jingwen did not take office and was transferred to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 徐石麒坐議獄，落職閑住。

translations.literal: Xu Shiqi lost his post and lived in retirement for debating a prison case.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shiqi lost his post and lived in retirement for debating a prison case.

sentences.zh: 胡應臺再召不赴。

translations.literal: Hu Yingtai was summoned again but did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yingtai was summoned again but declined to return.

sentences.zh: 繼其後者張忻，賊陷京師，與子庶吉士端並降。

translations.literal: His successor Zhang Xin, when rebels took the capital, surrendered together with his son Duan, a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: His successor Zhang Xin, when rebels took the capital, surrendered together with his son Duan, a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：崔景榮、黃克纘皆不為東林所與，然特不附東林耳。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Cui Jingrong and Huang Kezuan were both not accepted by the Eastern Forest, yet they simply did not attach themselves to the Eastern Forest.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Cui Jingrong and Huang Kezuan were both shunned by the Eastern Forest, yet they simply refused to join it.

sentences.zh: 方東林勢盛，羅天下清流，士有落然自異者，詬誶隨之矣。

translations.literal: When the Eastern Forest was at the height of power it gathered the pure streams of the realm; any gentleman who stood apart was followed by abuse and slander.
translations.idiomatic: When the Eastern Forest was at the height of power it gathered the pure streams of the realm; any gentleman who stood apart was followed by abuse and slander.

sentences.zh: 攻東林者，幸其近己也，而援以為重。

translations.literal: Those who attacked the Eastern Forest rejoiced that such men were near themselves and used them for added weight.
translations.idiomatic: Those who attacked the Eastern Forest rejoiced that such men were near themselves and used them for added weight.

sentences.zh: 於是中立者類不免蒙小人之玷。

translations.literal: Thus the neutral commonly could not avoid being stained by the mark of petty men.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the neutral commonly could not avoid being stained by association with petty men.

sentences.zh: 核人品者，乃專以與東林厚薄為輕重，豈篤論哉？

translations.literal: Those who weighed character looked only to thickness or thinness of ties with the Eastern Forest as the measure of worth—is this sound judgment?
translations.idiomatic: Those who weighed character looked only to one's distance from or closeness to the Eastern Forest as the measure of worth—is this sound judgment?

sentences.zh: 畢自嚴、李長庚計臣中辦治才，而自嚴增賦之議，識者病焉。

translations.literal: Bi Ziyan and Li Zhanggeng were men of practical administrative talent among revenue officials, yet Ziyan's proposal to increase land tax was deplored by the discerning.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Ziyan and Li Zhanggeng were men of practical administrative talent among revenue officials, yet Ziyan's proposal to increase land tax was deplored by the discerning.

sentences.zh: 劉之鳳議獄不當，罪止謫罷，竟予重比，刑罰不中，欲求治得乎！

translations.literal: Liu Zhifeng's judgment in a prison case was improper; the offense warranted only dismissal, yet a heavy sentence was imposed—when punishments are not balanced, can good government be sought!
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhifeng's judgment in a prison case was improper; the offense warranted only dismissal, yet a heavy sentence was imposed—when punishments are not balanced, can good government be sought!
